[[File:Helicarrier.jpg|thumb|183x183px|Hellicarrier]]
The [[Research Lab]] is the facility on the [[Helicarrier]] that allows upgrading other Helicarrier's facilities and the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Mobile_Command Mobile Command], as well as researching new units and equipments that can be attached to units increasing their stats. The Research Lab will become available to players when they reach level X*. There are three research brunches: [[Armory]], [[Helicarrier]] and [[Equipment]].

The Research Lab's Armory is where you can research new units; only after researching a given unit that it becomes available to be fused at the [[Armory]].
[[File:Research Lab-0.jpg|thumb|220x220px|Research Lab]]
The Research Lab's [[Helicarrier]] is where you can research upgrades for Mobile Command, [[Generator]], [[Squad Bay]] and [[Havoc Scans]].

The Research Lab's Equipment is where you can research equipments; only after researching a given [[Equipment]] that it becomes available to be produced at the [[Armory]].

Each research requires a certain amount of [[Credits]] to be done and it takes some time before it's done, from minutes to days.

<nowiki>*</nowiki> Research Lab becomes available in one of the early levels; I used X instead since I don't remember exactly at what level the Research Lab is unlocked.
